responsibility: Defines `EvalCtxt`, the central next-solver evaluation context that owns solver-local inference interaction, nested-goal queues, opaque and universe bookkeeping, proof-tree recording hooks, and helper operations for adding, normalizing, and evaluating goals within a search-graph-driven solver session.
same_name_distinction: Among the `solve/*/mod.rs` files, this one is the stateful execution context: it defines `EvalCtxt`, nested-goal management, response merging/floundering helpers, and controlled access to inference operations during solving. Unlike the root `solve` module or the assembly/project/inspect submodule roots, it is the runtime context in which those pieces execute.
